verses.text: Israel did what Yahweh said was wrong, so Yahweh handed them over to Midian for seven years. 😔
Midian had Israel pressed down so hard that the Israelites made hideouts for themselves in the mountains—caves and fortified spots. 🏔️
Whenever Israel planted crops, the Midianites, Amalekites, and eastern peoples would roll in against them. 🌾
They camped nearby and wrecked the land’s produce all the way to Gaza. Israel had no food left, and no sheep, cattle, or donkeys either. 🚫
They came with their livestock and tents, swarming in numbers like locusts. Their camels were countless, and they came to wipe the land out. 🦗
Midian had Israel brought way down, so the Israelites cried out to Yahweh. 🙏
When the Israelites cried to Yahweh because of Midian, 📣
Yahweh sent a prophet to them, who said, ‘Yahweh, Israel’s God, says: I brought you up from Egypt and out of slavery. 🗣️
I rescued you from the Egyptians and everyone who oppressed you. I drove them out ahead of you and gave you their land. 🛡️
I told you, “I am Yahweh your God. Don’t worship the Amorite gods in whose land you now live.” But you didn’t listen to me.’ 📜
Then Yahweh’s angel came and sat under the oak at Ophrah, on Joash the Abiezrite’s land. His son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress, hiding it from Midian. 🌾
Yahweh’s angel appeared to him and said, ‘Yahweh is with you, mighty warrior!’ ⚔️

Gideon said, ‘Please, sir, if Yahweh is with us, why is all this happening? Where are all the amazing things our ancestors told us about—how Yahweh brought us up from Egypt? Now it feels like Yahweh has left us and handed us to Midian.’ 😟
Yahweh looked at him and said, ‘Go with the strength you have and rescue Israel from Midian. I’m sending you, aren’t I?’ 💪
Gideon replied, ‘Please, Lord, how can I rescue Israel? My clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I’m the least in my family.’ 🤷
Yahweh said, ‘I’ll be with you. You’ll strike the Midianites down like they’re just one man.’ 🤝
Gideon said, ‘If I’ve found favor with you, please give me a sign that it’s really you talking with me. 🙏
Please stay here till I come back with my offering and set it before you.’ He answered, ‘I’ll wait right here.’ ⏳
Gideon went in, cooked a young goat, and baked unleavened bread with an ephah of flour. He put the meat in a basket, the broth in a pot, brought it under the oak, and served it. 🍞
God’s angel told him, ‘Put the meat and unleavened bread on that rock, then pour the broth over them.’ Gideon did it. 🪨
Yahweh’s angel reached out with the staff in his hand and touched the meat and bread. Fire shot up from the rock and consumed them; then the angel disappeared. 🔥
Gideon realized he’d seen Yahweh’s angel face-to-face and cried, ‘Oh no, Lord Yahweh! I’ve seen Yahweh’s angel right in front of me!’ 😨
Yahweh told him, ‘Peace to you. Don’t be afraid; you’re not going to die.’ 🕊️
Gideon built an altar there to Yahweh and named it ‘Yahweh Is Peace.’ It’s still in Ophrah, where the Abiezrites live. 🕊️
That night Yahweh told him, ‘Take your father’s bull—the second bull, seven years old. Tear down your father’s Baal altar, and cut down the Asherah pole beside it. 🌙
Then build an altar to Yahweh your God on this stronghold, set it up properly, and offer the second bull as a burnt offering, using the Asherah wood you cut down.’ 🔥
Gideon took ten of his servants and did what Yahweh told him. But he was scared of his family and the townspeople, so he did it at night instead of in daylight. 🌃
The townspeople got up early and saw Baal’s altar smashed, the Asherah pole cut down, and the second bull offered on the altar that had been built. 👀
They asked each other, ‘Who did this?’ They checked around and found out: Gideon son of Joash did it. 🔎
Then the men of the town told Joash, ‘Bring your son out! He has to die because he smashed Baal’s altar and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.’ 😠

Joash answered everyone standing against him, ‘Are you really going to defend Baal? Are you going to save him? Whoever argues for Baal should be put to death by morning! If he’s a god, let him defend himself—someone tore down his altar!’ 🗣️
That day Joash named Gideon Jerub-Baal, meaning, ‘Let Baal argue with him,’ because Gideon had torn Baal’s altar down. 🏷️
Then all the Midianites, Amalekites, and eastern peoples joined forces, crossed over, and camped in the Jezreel Valley. ⚔️
Yahweh’s Spirit came over Gideon. He blew a trumpet, and the Abiezrites rallied behind him. 📯
Gideon sent messengers throughout Manasseh, and they rallied too. He sent messengers to Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali, and they came up to meet them. 📨
Gideon said to God, ‘If you’re going to rescue Israel through me, just as you said, 🙏
then I’ll lay a wool fleece on the threshing floor. If dew lands on the fleece alone and the ground stays dry, I’ll know you’ll rescue Israel through me, just like you said.’ 🐑
And that’s what happened. Gideon got up early the next morning, squeezed the fleece, and wrung out a whole bowl of water. 💧
Gideon said to God, ‘Please don’t be angry with me; let me ask one more thing. Please let me test this once more with the fleece: make only the fleece dry, and let dew cover all the ground.’ 🙏
That night God did it: only the fleece was dry, while dew covered all the ground. 🌙
